name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Flight & Signal Heist Puzzles
promotionalText: Three free modes: Endless flight, daily crystal-gate Relay and the new 3D Signal Heist. Created by Mcaulee Maddison for offline portrait play.
description:
SkyPulse Arcade is Mcaulee Maddison’s mechanical-bird and signal-routing arcade: three free offline modes with their own scenery, controls and progress.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap, thread the gates and collect crystals as you chase your best. Travel from Neon City through Aurora Rise and Solar Drift to Cobalt Storm, Amber Skies and Polar Glow. Twelve environments change every 15 gates before the route repeats. Reflective cylindrical gate hardware adds depth to the illustrated worlds.

PULSE RELAY
Fly four fresh daily circuits through an orbital station. Collect both randomly placed crystals for each numbered gate. Red lasers guard each locked hoop. The first crystal charges half its ring; at 2/2 the lasers turn blue and the gate opens automatically. Missing crystals leave it locked. Tap freely to fly through hollow 3D hoops at varying heights, avoid the runway and reach the green exit to earn a medal. Each UTC day brings new named routes. Today’s routes and medals remain stable across app restarts. Fly past moving station machinery and rotating crystal cores with a single tap-to-flap control, then choose Next Mission after a clear.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Break into eight increasingly demanding Signal Heist vaults. Tap prisms to rotate mirrors and route live energy on a 3D optical console with glass modules and mechanical shutters. Keep every core and the uplink powered together to extract the vault. Splitters send the beam along two branches; energized relays open matching shutters. Red security sensors raise the trace cost of a rotation. Every turn spends trace, so plan your route before the budget runs out. Each extraction saves your medal and immediately activates the next puzzle, with no Next button or celebration delay. Restart a failed attempt or return later to your saved unfinished configuration.

DAILY MISSION CONTROL
Complete four tasks across your attempts and claim five crystals for each, up to 20 daily-task crystals per UTC day. The daily reset time appears in your local time zone.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Earn crystals to unlock 15 cosmetic birds with equal flight handling. Explore one connected 3D holographic Tech Tree by dragging in any direction. Its nine upgrade families each have three levels, improving the Endless Route collection and reward effects shown in the game. Mission medals and Endless best are saved separately.

THREE MODES, THREE HOMES
Home starts on Endless Route. Tap the top-left badge to select a free mode. Each Home has its own rendered 3D display, scenery, animation, progress and relevant controls: flight collection, Relay circuits and cosmetic Hangar, or Blackout vault map and field guide.

Return to the selected mode’s Home with Main Menu after each run. Portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with Reduced Motion and haptic controls. Play offline with no advertising, account or real-money purchases. Progress and preferences are saved on your device.
